name: myxpns
description: A simple, privacy-conscious personal/family expense and receipt tracker backed by your own Google Sheet and Google Drive.

scripts.build:staging: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode staging
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && vite build
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && vite build --mode staging && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run check && vite build --mode production && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:production
